name: shortenurl
description: URL shortener — React client + Express API. This root package only orchestrates the two.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta --kill-others "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
